dish_en: Yakiniku Don, Japanese grilled beef rice bowl with onion
product_desc: thin slices of marbled wagyu beef fanned out on a pale wooden cutting board, fat marbling fine and white through deep red meat, laid directly on the wood with no tray, no packaging and no text anywhere in frame
cook: a cook in his thirties in a dark apron, fast and confident, working at a hot pan
kitchen: a compact modern kitchen with a stainless counter and a strong gas ring, neutral daylight from a window on the left, warm only in the shadows
prep_subject: thin slices of marbled beef laid out flat and separated on a wooden cutting board so no two overlap, beside a mound of onion sliced into thin half-moons and a small bowl of dark yakiniku tare already mixed, with a spoon standing in it. A bowl of hot steamed rice sits behind
prep_defines: the thinness of the beef slices and the fact that they are laid separately rather than clumped
cook_vessel: a heavy flat pan over a strong gas ring
cook_subject: the pan partway through, sliced onion softening and going translucent at the edges while thin beef slices sear beside them, the meat turning from red to brown at its edges and curling as it takes the heat. No sauce is in the pan yet
cook_negatives: beef stewed in liquid, grey boiled meat, a thick gravy, sauce added before the beef is seared, thick steak-cut beef instead of thin slices
vessel_start: empty except for a film of oil just beginning to smoke, no food in it yet
hero_subject: the finished bowl, hot rice covered with glossy dark-glazed beef slices and soft onion, a raw egg yolk sitting whole in a hollow at the centre, chopped spring onion and toasted sesame scattered over, with the sauce catching the light on the meat
hero_setting: a wooden counter in the same kitchen, chopsticks resting across the bowl, neutral daylight
story: onion into a smoking empty pan to soften
beef slices in beside it and seared fast, then the tare poured over
onto rice, egg yolk set in the centre, sesame and spring onion
first_heat: The sliced onion hits the smoking bare metal and begins to hiss and go translucent at the edges, and a first curl of steam lifts from the pan.
transform: the onion softens from opaque white to translucent gold, the thin beef slices go in beside it and turn from deep red to brown at the edges within seconds, curling as they sear, and the tare is poured over and reduces immediately to a dark glossy glaze that coats every slice.
lift: A pair of cooking chopsticks enters from the left, lifts one glazed beef slice clear of the pan and holds it at the centre of frame, the glaze running off it slowly and the surface catching the light.
plate: The hands of <Subject 1> enter from the top of frame holding the pan by its handle, tip the glazed beef and onion out over the bowl of hot rice in one motion so they cover it completely, and withdraw out of frame with the empty pan.
final_lift: A hand enters from the right holding chopsticks, lifts one glazed beef slice from the top of the bowl and holds it steady at the centre of frame, the egg yolk visible whole below it.

beats.c1s1: <Subject 1> draws the wooden board of beef slices and the sliced onion toward them in one movement.
beats.c1s2: Both hands of <Subject 1> separate the thin beef slices on the board so none overlap and slide it to the near edge beside the sliced onion, with the bowl of mixed tare set apart.
beats.c1s3: The hands of <Subject 1> enter from the top of frame carrying the sliced onion, tip it into the empty smoking pan first, and withdraw straight up out of frame empty. No beef and no sauce go in during this shot.
beats.c3s2: The hand of <Subject 1> enters from the top of frame holding half an eggshell and slides a whole raw yolk into a hollow at the centre of the beef in one movement, then withdraws straight up out of frame. The yolk sits whole and unbroken on top.

clip02_shot1: [Shot 1] Locked-off close-up at pan height, 50mm feel, continuing directly from <Picture 1>. The pan of <Picture 4> fills the lower two thirds of frame over its gas ring, which stays visible at the bottom of frame throughout, the onion from clip 01 already softening and going translucent. The hands of <Subject 1> enter from the top of frame carrying the separated beef slices from <Picture 3>, lay them flat into the pan beside the onion one at a time so none overlap, and withdraw straight up out of frame empty. The slices sear the moment they land and the sound sharpens. No sauce is in this shot. The camera does not move at any point in this shot, and the framing does not drift.
negatives_global: thick steak-cut beef, grey boiled meat, beef stewed in liquid, a thick gravy, sauce added before searing, a broken egg yolk
sound_01: A compact kitchen with a low extractor hum. In the first shot, a tray set down on a stainless counter. In the second shot, the soft sound of thin beef slices being separated and laid flat, and a spoon stirring sauce in a bowl. In the third shot, a gas ring at full roar, then onion hitting smoking bare metal with a sharp hiss. No speech.
sound_02: A hard fast sear throughout, sharpening as each beef slice lands, then a short violent hiss as the tare hits the hot pan and reduces. The scrape of chopsticks against metal. No speech.
sound_03: A kitchen at full heat. In the first shot, glazed beef sliding from a pan onto rice. In the second shot, the small soft sound of an egg yolk slipping from its shell. In the third shot, chopsticks lifting a slice, and a bowl set down on wood. No speech.
music: A tight modern bed: a clipped drum groove under a warm bass line, quick and appetising, landing on the sear.
